prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. Input is the EXACT pale-green atomic-star laminate albedo. Preserve square crop and orientation. The laminate is almost perfectly FLAT: output an almost uniform neutral midgray height plane, with only extremely faint existing physical scratches if visible. All atomic stars, flecks, color variations and green/gray print are pigment below a smooth laminate finish and MUST NOT become bumps, grooves or holes. Remove all pattern contrast, lighting, shadows and color. This is an intentionally nearly flat low-contrast grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE, NOT a purple normal map or decorative recolor. No added seams, stones, grains, cracks, bevels, border, text, crop or rotation.
reference_invariants: Original albedo is untouched. Output is only supplemental guide; final geometric features come from original-source masks.
limitations: The generated guide is not accepted as an exact per-pixel geometry match.
Generated guides can contain interpreted shading; periodic bandpass and tiny guide weight suppress it.
Exact model version is not exposed.
